title: 7-Zip native format property reconstruction study
scope: x64 7za.dll single format GetHandlerProperty2 descriptor dispatch; no archive compressor or decompressor
method: conservative source-assisted and investigator-assisted; REA Ghidra pseudocode and xrefs, calibrated original native export observations, Python reconstruction
findings: index beyond count returns invalid argument HRESULT
unknown property on valid index yields success and empty variant
signature and binary identifier stored as byte-length BSTR
registry xrefs succeeded on bounded retry after resource failure
limitations: calibrated constants and partly overlapping comparison set
model excludes allocation failure and ABI misuse
11 signature checks are model-only, not archive validation
separate pwntools PE layout facet unsupported
